claims: The match was an international friendly
The match was on Thursday, March 26, 2026
The match was held at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, Florida
The match was part of preparations for the 2026 World Cup
Jhon Arias opened the scoring for Colombia in the 3rd minute
Luka Vušković equalized for Croatia in the 6th minute with a shot from outside the box
Igor Matanović scored for Croatia in the 42nd minute after a mistake by Colombian goalkeeper Camilo Vargas
Luis Suárez missed a significant chance for Colombia to go ahead before halftime
Vargas; Munoz, Sanchez, Lucumi, Mojica; Rios, Lerma; James Rodriguez, Arias, Diaz; Suarez
Livaković; Erlić, Vušković, Pongračić; Marco Pašalić, Moro, P. Sučić, Perišić; Mario Pašalić, Vlašić; Matanović
The friendly match served as a warm-up for the 2026 World Cup in North America
